notes: INSIDE half of the Heavy Battery (breech, outward = up; the top flange overhangs the inner wall face, see offset): a slug core with the heavy_burst add-on, the feed column, power coupling, repair hatch on the wide ones, 5-cell charge strip. charge: frame i lights i of the 5 cells (5 = ready); fire: the strip flashes, then goes dark. damaged: a dead cell, a crack, sparks; disabled: dark, cracked. Module family gun_breech.py (2x2, 4x2, 2x4), in the line of the gun. The rotating head is heavy_battery_barrel.
